summary: EGroupware is a server-hosted suite designed for team collaboration and administrative tasks. It provides tools such as shared calendars, address books, notepads, project tracking, and customer relationship management within a single platform.
goodFor: Teams looking to consolidate scheduling, project tracking, and contact management into a single self-hosted environment.
watchOut: It covers a very broad feature set, which may introduce unnecessary complexity if you only require basic calendar or contact synchronisation.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, it typically requires a web server like Apache or Nginx, a separate relational database such as MariaDB or MySQL, and persistent storage for user-uploaded files.
